title: Sleep Apnea Triggers of Atrial Fibrillation: N-of-1 Randomized Control Trial (SPARTA):
official: Sleep Apnea Triggers of Atrial Fibrillation: N-of-1 Randomized Control Trial (SPARTA):
summary: A pilot N-of-1 randomized controlled trial evaluating the effectiveness of a personalized CPAP intervention in reducing atrial fibrillation (AF) burden and improving AF-related quality of life in patients with moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Informed consent
2. Age 18-85 years
3. High burden paroxysmal AF (≥1%)
4. Moderate-severe OSA (AHI ≥ 15)
5. Implanted device with atrial diagnostics
6. Enrolled in remote monitoring

Exclusion Criteria:

1. AF ablation \<6 months
2. Valvular abnormalities
3. Excessive daytime sleepiness in safety-critical jobs
4. Plans for ablation during study
5. Non-CPAP OSA treatment
6. Recent device implantation (\<6 months)
7. Central sleep apnea
